facts.fact: NRF's Holiday survey found a record 183.4 million people planning to shop in-store and online from Thanksgiving Day through Cyber Monday in 2024.
facts.quote: are planning to shop in-store and online from Thanksgiving Day through Cyber Monday this year

facts.fact: The 2024 NRF figure of 183.4 million is up from the previous record of 182 million in 2023.
facts.quote: The figure is up from the previous record of 182 million in 2023

facts.fact: The NRF Holiday survey reports 18.1 million more people planning to shop Thanksgiving through Cyber Monday than five years earlier in 2019.
facts.quote: 18.1 million more people than five years ago in 2019.

facts.fact: In the NRF survey, 57% of shoppers plan to shop during Thanksgiving weekend because of deals and discounts.
facts.quote: 57% of shoppers plan to shop during Thanksgiving weekend because of deals and discounts

facts.fact: In the NRF survey, 28% of shoppers plan to shop during Thanksgiving weekend because of tradition.
facts.quote: 28% plan to shop because of tradition

facts.fact: In the NRF survey, 24% of shoppers reported they like to start holiday shopping early as a reason to shop Thanksgiving weekend.
facts.quote: 24% reported they like to start holiday shopping early

facts.fact: Black Friday is the most popular shopping day in the NRF survey, with 72% (131.7 million people) planning to shop in stores or online.
facts.quote: Black Friday remains the most popular day to shop, with 72%, or 131.7 million people planning to go to stores or shop online.

facts.fact: About two-thirds of Black Friday shoppers in the NRF survey expect to specifically shop in stores that day.
facts.quote: About two-thirds of Black Friday shoppers expect to specifically shop in stores that day.

facts.fact: Cyber Monday is the second most popular shopping day in the NRF survey, attracting 39% (72.3 million people) of those planning to shop.
facts.quote: Cyber Monday is the second most popular day, attracting 39%, or 72.3 million of those planning to shop.

facts.fact: In the NRF survey, 58% of consumers had already started their holiday shopping as of early November 2024.
facts.quote: The trend of early holiday shopping continues with 58% of consumers having already started their holiday shopping as of early November.

facts.fact: Per Prosper Insights & Analytics, 89% of young adults aged 18-24 plan to shop over the Thanksgiving weekend.
facts.quote: with 89% of young adults between 18-24 planning to shop over the weekend

facts.fact: Per the NRF survey, half of consumers not currently planning to shop the holiday weekend could be convinced to do so if items they want are on sale or friends or family invite them.
facts.quote: Half of the interviewed consumers not currently planning to shop during the holiday weekend could be convinced to do so if items they want are on sale or if friends or family invite them.

facts.fact: U.S. Census Bureau data cited by NRF shows retail sales grew over the past two months (as of the October 2024 release).
facts.quote: shows retail sales grew the past two months
